name: Hashrate expansion confirms a BTC trend — btc_hashrate cross-up on positive 30-day BTC momentum
rationale: Thesis: rising hashrate reflects miners committing more capital/energy — a low-frequency 'smart-money conviction' signal. When hashrate accelerates UP while BTC is already in an uptrend, the trend has structural backing and tends to persist. btc_hashrate drifts up secularly (and across halvings), so only a cross_up is meaningful, never a level. We confirm with positive medium-horizon BTC momentum (30d-ish) so we are not catching a hashrate bump into a downtrend. Disconfirmer 1: replace the hashrate cross_up with a permuted-lag copy of the same series — if the deflated Sharpe is unchanged, the cross timing is information-free and the apparent edge is the momentum leg alone. Disconfirmer 2: hashrate is slow and lagging; if shortening the momentum lookback to a few days (so the trend leg dominates) absorbs all the Sharpe, hashrate adds nothing. BTC-only, long-only spot, longer hold to match the slow signal.
catalyst: btc_hashrate crosses up through its expansion threshold while medium-horizon BTC momentum is positive
